title: Setup text - need to make it less
symptom: On Q1 Pro, only January 2018 version can be installed; later versions (alpha, beta) cannot be installed because the installation prompt text is too long and the Install button is not reachable on small screens.
fix: The only solution mentioned is to remove the existing app and install fresh, but this is not a fix for the issue.
evidence_quote: not able to click "Install", due to small screen size. By now only solution is to remove existing and install fresh.
